QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_67

question.text: Data provided as on March 31 every year to Benchmarking Agencies must be:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 6.2(e), March 31 data must be audited; September 30 may be unaudited. The Trap: Unaudited/estimated/provisional data is unacceptable for March 31. Cross-Exam Context: Same audit timing in Cat I/II. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Line up investee-company audits and fund audit in a way that March data is ready by September benchmarking report.
